hero.heading: Vintage
hero.subheading: Vintage fashion, restored furniture, and one-of-a-kind pieces selected for character, usefulness, or beauty.

manifesto.heading: Selected for character, usefulness, or beauty.
manifesto.body: Every piece in the Alley 21 collection has been chosen deliberately — whether it's a vintage garment, a restored furniture piece, a distinctive accessory, or an unexpected find. Nothing is here by accident.

categories.label: Vintage Fashion
categories.description: Carefully sourced vintage clothing and accessories from eras worth revisiting.

categories.label: Art and Collectibles
categories.description: Original art, antique porcelain, and distinctive collectibles selected for quality and uncommon appeal.

categories.label: Designer Accessories
categories.description: Vintage and pre-owned designer accessories — bags, scarves, jewelry, and more.

categories.label: Furniture and Home
categories.description: Restored, refinished, and reimagined furniture pieces and unique home accents.

pillars.title: Selective sourcing
pillars.description: Every piece is chosen for a reason — quality, character, history, or usefulness. We don't collect volume for its own sake.

pillars.title: Honest description
pillars.description: Items are described accurately. Condition, provenance, and any relevant details are shared clearly.

pillars.title: Local and hands-on
pillars.description: Sourcing, restoration, and curation happen locally in Bay County. Each piece is handled directly.
